summary: Metalpha Technology Holding Ltd furnished a Form 6-K on August 6, 2026, announcing its audited FY2026 financial results via press release. Revenue reached $37.1 million with continued profitability, and total assets nearly doubled to $485.6 million. The annual report on Form 20-F was filed the same day. This is a routine earnings and annual report disclosure for a foreign private issuer, not a special-situation event. No transaction, strategic review, or corporate action is described. The filing serves as an ordinary results update with forward-looking statements, and no special-situation category applies.
